name: LBS
recent: LBS Bina 近期持续进行股份回购，集团执行主席 Tan Sri Lim Hock San 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。公司于11月18日公布季度业绩，并宣布将 sukuk 计划规模扩大至 RM1.5bil。公司同时推进位于 Kwasa Damansara、发展总值 RM8.3bil 的 The Reserva 项目，计划于2027年4月推出。
notable: 集团执行主席 Tan Sri Lim Hock San 在11月17日至26日期间多次增持公司股份。
公司于11月18日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。
公司将 sukuk 计划规模扩大一倍至 RM1.5bil。
risks: 公司在11月多次进行股份回购。
分析师近期大幅下调了对 LBS Bina 的盈利预测。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM340.464mil，环比增长14.8%，同比增长9.9%；净利为 RM15.049mil，环比下降11.6%，同比下降44.4%；净利率为4.4%，低于上一季度的5.7%。

recent_en: LBS Bina has been actively buying back its shares, while Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Lim Hock San has repeatedly acquired shares in the open market. The company released its quarterly results on 18 November and doubled its sukuk programme size to RM1.5bil. It is also progressing with The Reserva in Kwasa Damansara, a RM8.3bil GDV project targeted for launch in April 2027.
notable_en: Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Lim Hock San acquired shares multiple times between 17 and 26 November.
The company announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 18 November.
The company doubled its sukuk programme size to RM1.5bil.
risks_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks in November.
Analysts recently made a substantial cut to their earnings estimates for LBS Bina.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM340.464mil, up 14.8% QoQ and 9.9% YoY; net income was RM15.049mil, down 11.6% QoQ and 44.4% YoY; net margin was 4.4% versus 5.7% in the prior quarter.
